pageTitle: Grains, Games & Gratitude — Back to Roots

program.title: Grains, Games & Gratitude
program.description: Create, learn, play, and give back! From crafting mandala art with millets to discovering their nutritional power, enjoying Lagori, and making a heartfelt gratitude card—this journey is all about creativity, tradition, and joy.

items.title: Millet Mandala Magic
items.description: Kids collect millets and create stunning mandala art.

items.title: Power of Millets
items.description: Learn about the nutritional value of millets and their benefits for each organ.

items.title: Lagori Fun Blast
items.description: Enjoy a traditional outdoor game that brings energy and teamwork.

items.title: Gratitude from the Heart
items.description: Turn your mandala art into a gratitude card for loved ones.
